title: AmbiGen: Generating Ambigrams from Pre-trained Diffusion Model
queries: AmbiGen: Generating Ambigrams from Pre-trained Diffusion Model
journal: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2024)
notes: コンピュータビジョン最高峰学会 CVPR 2024採録論文。大規模拡散モデルの構造事前分布を蒸留し、文字アウトライン（ベクター輪郭）の直接最適化によるアンビグラム生成手法。
abstract: An ambigram is a visual art form of calligraphy that can be viewed and read from multiple perspectives, typically under a 180-degree rotation. Creating ambigrams requires both artistic creativity and immense manual effort to satisfy the dual readability constraints. In this paper, we propose AmbiGen, an automated approach to generate calligraphic ambigrams by distilling knowledge from pre-trained diffusion models. Specifically, we optimize character outlines to balance readability and aesthetic quality across dual views.
